items.name: BrizZon Sylwester Open 2022
items.information: Drugi rok z rzędu klub Brizzon zaprasza na sylwestrowe zawody, gwarantujemy dobrą zabawę zarówno w trakcie jak i po zawodach, gdy będziemy żegnać kończący się rok, a następnie świętować początek nowego! Prosimy o zapoznanie się z [zakładką z ważnymi informacjami co do sposobu przeprowadzenia tych zawodów!](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BrizZonSylwesterOpen2022#22867-wazne-format-zawodow-important-format-of-the-competition) --- Second year in the row we would like to invite you for New Year's Eve competition in Brizzon Snooker Club. We guarantee a lot fun both during the competiton and after it, when we'll be saying goodbye to the ending year and then celebrate the beginning of a new one! Please make sure to read the [important information about format of this competition tab!](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BrizZonSylwesterOpen2022#22867-wazne-format-zawodow-important-format-of-the-competition)

items.name: New York New Year 2023
items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab. All competitors must read the COVID Safety tab before registering, as proof of full vaccination or a negative test will be required. **Competitors may bring at most one guest.** Please note that this competition will take place from **4pm** on New Year's Eve (December 31, 2022) to **2am** on New Year's Day (January 1, 2023).
